about_the_game:
A cowardly warrior, a gullible thief, a clumsy sorceress, and priestess who can't heal are off on an adventure! The monsters and villains of the magical world will tremble with fear... or with laughter!

Behind the simple graphics of Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 is a big RPG with 50+ hours of gameplay. and If you dare to lead this team of clumsy heroines, you can expect:

Lots of different quests! Work for the Warrior's Guild, give sermons, protect trade caravans, and even rescue wild boars from crazy adventurers!

Explore a big map! Walk through the streets of three cities. Go into every crypt and cave you can find. Discover all the hidden secrets.

Manage your family estate! Accept requests, invest in fixing and building up the place, make deals to earn money, and don't forget to pay your taxes!

Less grinding, more rewards! There are no endless waves of enemies, and all the dungeons are made by hand. Collect legendary items and equipment to make your team ready for anything.

Finally, Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 has a lot of reading. There are over 250,000 words of story text in the game! The developer really went all out! He hopes you'll enjoy the world he's created and its funny characters.

content_descriptors.notes: Use of Alcohol, Drug Reference, Mild to moderate use of profanity, Partial Nudity

short_description: A game for players who adore humorous fantasy adventures. A sprawling turn-based JRPG offering 50 hours of meticulously crafted plot, engaging quests, and no unnecessary grind. Four gorgeous yet utterly misguided heroines set out on perilous yet wildly entertaining adventures.
